content: पालन {%a.%} [पाल्-भावे ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Protecting, guarding <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Ki. 1. 1</ls>. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Protecting, guarding, nourishing, cherishing, fostering; लब्ध˚ <ls>R. 19. 3</ls>; so प्रजा˚, क्षिति˚, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Maintaining, observing, keeping (as a promise, vow <ab>&c.</ab>) .²3 The milk of a cow that has recently calved. .²4 the sharpening (of arms); शस्त्राणां पालनं ज्ञानं <ls>Mb. 12. 59. 46</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> शस्त्राणां पालनं तीक्ष्णीकरणम्).
